steps.prompt: Remember for this project: report text files are written as UTF-16 little-endian with a byte order mark. Later sessions in this repository may need what you learn here.
Read every file under docs/ in full and write SUMMARY.md in the repository root with one paragraph per file describing its sections.
Implement save(path, text) in textio.py: write text to the file at path in this project's report file encoding.
